Keep her ORIGINAL side-on forward-leaning desk-chair STUDY posture and downward reading gaze exactly. Both original forearms/hands touch the same paper, including the actual small held pen. Preserve all original contact/occlusion relationships. No crop, zoom, enlargement, separate person scaling, pose change, body/face redesign or new furniture/object/person.

Relight the WHOLE image 1 room AND Umiri using the same reference-locked rose-gold low window light and quiet violet shadows. Warm hair/skin/window edges agree with this sun axis; no purple skin, green cast, gray desaturation or flat full-image orange/purple filter. It and the one reference-position sunset are the only depicted sources: no new lamp, left-rear spotlight, unexplained light cone or black/white overlay.

Maintain image 1's lived-in left depth and clear central floor; preserve fine original youthful anime linework and softly detailed environment. No text, UI, logos, watermark, split-screen, panel, arrows, inset, borders, cloud/sky collage or duplicate view. Return the full same-person, same-pose, same-furniture scene with the approved reference's exact sun/reflection axis.
